name: game.placeBlock
description: Decides placing one block of a ship from its design's outline.

spec.title: Place a ship block
spec.description: Places one block of a ship, by its index in the ship's design (game.shipDesigns); the target is the ship's id. Blocks may be placed in any order; a thruster pushes, the gyroscope turns and the cockpit seats a pilot only once placed. Refused when the ship does not exist, the index is not one of its design's blocks or the block is already placed. V31: a ship of a chip design (the cutter) keeps its block types (Ship.types), and each block costs components taken from the sender's pack (armor 2 plates; cockpit 3 plates and 2 wire; thruster a nozzle, a plate and a wire; gyro 2 plates and 3 wire; battery 2 battery cells and a wire; solar 2 solar cells and a wire; light a wire; cargo 4 plates; V32: refinery 6 plates and 4 wire; V33: concrete 2 bags of cement); refused when the pack is short.

index.description: The block's index in the design's blocks

outputs.description: The block's index in the design

config.expr: let costs = {armor: {plate: 2}, cockpit: {plate: 3, wire: 2}, thruster: {nozzle: 1, plate: 1, wire: 1}, gyro: {plate: 2, wire: 3}, battery: {cell: 2, wire: 1}, solar: {solarCell: 2, wire: 1}, light: {wire: 1}, cargo: {plate: 4}, refinery: {plate: 6, wire: 4}, concrete: {cement: 2}}; let t = found && index >= 0 && int(index) == index && index < len(ship?.types ?? []) ? ship.types[int(index)] : ""; let cost = t == "" ? {} : (costs[t] ?? {}); let names = sort(keys(cost)); let short = filter(names, ((pack?.parts ?? {})[#] ?? 0) < cost[#]); let n = found && ship.design == "cabin" ? max(ship.blocks, 78) : (ship?.blocks ?? 0); !found ? "there is no ship " + target : index < 0 || index >= n || int(index) != index ? "the ship's blocks are 0 to " + string(n - 1) : index in ship.placed ? "block " + string(int(index)) + " is already placed" : len(short) > 0 ? "a " + t + " block costs " + join(map(names, string(int(cost[#])) + " " + #), ", ") + "; your pack is short of " + join(short, ", ") + ": refine more at a forge" : ""

let costs = {armor: {plate: 2}, cockpit: {plate: 3, wire: 2}, thruster: {nozzle: 1, plate: 1, wire: 1}, gyro: {plate: 2, wire: 3}, battery: {cell: 2, wire: 1}, solar: {solarCell: 2, wire: 1}, light: {wire: 1}, cargo: {plate: 4}, refinery: {plate: 6, wire: 4}, concrete: {cement: 2}}; let t = found && index >= 0 && int(index) == index && index < len(ship?.types ?? []) ? ship.types[int(index)] : ""; let cost = t == "" ? {} : (costs[t] ?? {}); let names = sort(keys(cost)); let short = filter(names, ((pack?.parts ?? {})[#] ?? 0) < cost[#]); t == "" ? {world: ship.world, index: int(index)} : {world: ship.world, index: int(index), pack: {parts: fromPairs(map(names, [#, -cost[#]]))}}

config.fix: place a block of the ship's outline that is not placed yet; a chip design's block needs its components in your pack (game.smelt refines them at a forge)
